apps.localizedDescription:
yaabsa:

An unofficial cross-platform app for Audiobookshelf.

Usage of AI:

As I myself criticize the lack of disclosure about AI, which most ABS apps now use, I want to be clear that later in the making of the app, AI/LLMs were used in the development process. I still know the API endpoints used very well and have already helped a ton of people with API usage.

Below is a list of all features, but I want to highlight a few, as this client has features that are only and or very rarely found in other clients:

• First client that supports Android Automotive (AAOS) for Audiobookshelf (ABS).
• Basic eBook/PDF support with syncable annotations.
• subtitle support with karaoke-style highlighting support (later planned to be extended like Whispersync).

versions.localizedDescription:
Added:

• Added chapter editor.
• Added file details.
• Added search within EPUB and PDF books.
• Added third party TTS provider.
• Integrated playback with media player.
• Added an in-app changelog.

Fixed:

• Listening progress now retries loading when the server becomes reachable after an offline or failed startup.
• Improved final progress syncing when a book finishes or playback moves to the next queued item.

Changed:

• Redesign of the ebook reader.
• Redesign of the book details page.
• Improved the item editor layout to match new Audiobookshelf design.
• Integrated read-aloud and embedded book narration with player controls and sleep timers.

This release has been automatically generated from commit 45474f01e86e7d4df5adeff75cf340d128597521.

You can download the built artifacts from the "Assets" section below.
